dog.description_text:
Please note: Any profiles with a "Pawling, NY" icon are located at the ASPCA Recovery & Rehabilitation Center, which is a 90-minute drive outside of the city. All other dogs are located in New York City.

Meet Randi, a gentle girl with a wonderfully silly side!

Around familiar friends, Randi lets her playful personality shine and has been known to celebrate with some seriously happy zoomies! Randi enjoys heading outside for walks, where she can take in her surroundings and explore at her own pace. Back inside, one of her favorite ways to have fun is figuring out puzzle toys, especially when there’s a tasty reward waiting inside. She’s always happy to put her brain to work for a good snack! Randi has a special way of making the people who know her smile, and our team would love for you to discover why. Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Randi’s team in Pawling, New York!

*We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: RANDI
